items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And, we had Joe Schultz, Joe, Joe Wolf playing piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, Stratikas, he was, he was a, not a, he was a good trombone player, but nothing, I mean, they were playing stock orchestration. This is no originality. And, we had Joe Schultz, Joe, Joe Wolf playing piano. And they used to call him Foxy Grandpa. He used to play like this. No rhythm at all, whatsoever. And we had a trump, a bass player by the name of Dave Fridge, who played the third trumpet on the, third trumpet on the tuba.
He wasn't playing boop, boop, boop. He was playing boop, boop, boop, boop.

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Did you remember Joe Schultz? ... He's dead. He's dead. What did Joe Schultz play? He played violin.

ctx.x: So you played in this band. Yeah, this is me. All right. All right. Come around here. Did you stay in the blue room after this band? No. After that, we went to the fountain lounge. Oh, okay. See, one of this took about... That's the blue room. This is one of the actual dance teams. This is... Did you remember Joe Schultz?
Oh, the name only. You've mentioned him to me.
